mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_path, m.menu_component, m.menu_icon, m.menu_sort, m.menu_visible, m.menu_permission FROM ch_menu m JOIN ch_role_menu rm ON rm.role_menu_menu_id = m.menu_id JOIN ch_role r ON r.role_id = rm.role_menu_role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND r.role_is_delete = 0 AND m.menu_is_delete = 0 ORDER BY m.menu_parent_id ASC, m.menu_sort ASC, m.menu_id ASC
